notes.title: Finally, the wait is over! The official release date is July 14th.
notes.notes:
Charming Heart, a fascinating visual novel game for gamers aged 18+ developed in Thailand, will be available on Steam soon. The official release date is July 14th. 

In Charming Heart, you'll take on the role of "Nut," who is harassed by the four mischievous Celestial Angels. They also prevent you from contacting "Mew," your crush. The story revolves around revenge, deep mysteries, and lewdness, and the outcome depends on your choices!

The full game includes:
-       Rich content with six chapters for your delightful enjoyment, along with English translation.
-       Full voice acting for the main characters in every scene.
-       Multiple endings based on your choices.
-       Achievement trophies to unlock on Steam.
-       Gallery to view past scenes and images.
-       Game acceleration by holding down the Ctrl key.
-       Option to mute/unmute the voice of the main character, "Nut."
-       Press the Esc key to access the emergency screen.

Get ready for the release on July 14th!
